rate-in-out.alt: Two rates on 0 ≤ t ≤ 12 minutes: water flows in at R(t) = 10 + 3 sin(πt/6) liters per minute (blue) and out at D(t) = 4 + t liters per minute (crimson). From t = 0 to 6 the rate in is larger and the gap is shaded green: the amount rises. The curves cross at t = 6, where both rates are 10. After that the rate out is larger and the gap is shaded vermillion: the amount falls. The amount is greatest at t = 6.
